description: The details at the top of a Reflection's file, practice/data/reflections/<id>.md. The text below them is FH's, in the writing desk's Markdown (tools/sitedata.py). slug fixes the page's address for good and is written by tools/build-reflections.py the first time. summary, if given, replaces the opening of the text in search results and shared links. origin names the Curator passage a Reflection began from. place, for a Reflection from practice, is where it came from in full, for example Suddhavari Monastery, São Lourenço, Brazil; the part before the first comma is its short form.
